scope: Two isolated same-host virtual real-daemon checks; no native desktop or matched Synergy runtime benchmark

plan.verification: all large transfers: new remote own-write stamp, exact byte count, new incoming transfer record; each 1 MiB transfer also full remote byte SHA256

control.purpose: Separate fixed diagnostic history serialization/cache retention from growing payload retention; no new RSS pass/fail gate

plan.polling: two extra virtual.recorded calls per node/cycle; stats uses since=u64::MAX, full uses since=0, both audit=true
plan.os_tools: vmmap -summary against owned Popen PIDs only; at prefill and each phase boundary
plan.bounds: 270s scheduled repeated workload plus prefill/snapshots; maximum 330s from setup to end of phases

control_analysis.conclusion: Controlled full-history polling caused resident free/fragmented Darwin malloc pages. Fixed-history operation showed a bounded high-water plateau in this run. No unbounded clipboard-buffer retention was reproduced.
control_analysis.scope_limit: Causal control identifies the diagnostic serialization/cache contribution. It does not retroactively classify every byte of the original 1.33 MiB/min slope, provide allocation stack traces, or prove a bound for all workloads.
control_analysis.tail_note: Tail has only 10 cycles, so its driver first10/last10 fields overlap and are not independent evidence. Use its min/max range and time trend, plus the preceding balanced full-both windows.
control_analysis.swapping_note: RSS decreases partly coincide with up to 416K server and 1104K client swapped malloc pages. The allocation counts, virtual zone/region bounds and resident-plus-swapped figures support the boundedness result independently of RSS falling.
control_analysis.no_product_bug_handoff: No unbounded retention defect reproduced in this fixed workload. Avoid full ledger retrieval for stats: use since=u64::MAX, or an explicit recent since cursor when reading events. Optional product work is a stats-only path and less JSON response materialization; no implementation was made.
